description: List check-account transactions (bank payments in and out), filterable by account, booking state, date range, payee/payer and purpose. sevdesk: GET /CheckAccountTransaction.

check_account_id.description: Only transactions on this check account id.

count_all.description: If true, the response also carries `total`, the full match count.

embed.description: Comma-separated nested resources to expand inline, e.g. contact,category.

end_date.description: Only transactions up to this date (ISO 8601).

is_booked.description: If true, only transactions already booked against a document.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip, for paging.

payee_payer_name.description: Only transactions with this payee / payer name.

payment_purpose.description: Only transactions with this payment purpose (Verwendungszweck).

start_date.description: Only transactions from this date on (ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-01-01).

name: sevdesk_list_transactions
title: List bank transactions
